- Right-to-left within each frame?
- Column-based ordering?

Col 28: Red frame slot, Green frame slot
Col 34: Green frame slot (T connector is in red frame)
Col 40: Red frame slot, Green frame slot

= Orange, Purple, Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Pink
